notes.title: Update 0.10.0
notes.content:
Hi friends,

first of all, a big thank you to our beta testers for helping us improve our updates and catch the bugs we missed. We truly appreciate your support!

For those interested in exploring the world of VR HOT beyond Steam (General News, our Patreon page with the Quest version and AI features, etc.), make sure to join our Discord server \[HERE] or check out our Patreon \[HERE]!



Path Tracing (Experimental)
Push visuals to the next level with experimental path tracing support, available only on high-end PCs (≥ RTX 4070 in VR). For the best experience, we recommend enabling DLSS.

To activate path tracing, open the Main Menu and go to Settings > Performance. Use the drop down menu for Indirect Light and select one of the Path Tracing options.



HottieCards with Positional Data
HottieCards are now even more powerful: in addition to storing appearance, clothing, and biographical details, they also save a Hottie’s exact position in the scene and body posture.



New Animation System with additional Animations
We have switched to a new animation system to support future upgrades and improvements. Alongside this change, we’ve added a variety of new animations - particularly focused on intercourse - to enrich interactions and increase variety.



Stable Editing
Certain sliders previously caused Hotties to “jump” during changes. They will now remain perfectly still while you edit.



Refined Animations
We’ve begun reworking our animations to make them more fluid, elegant, and life-like. This update includes the first of these enhanced animations.



Wet Skin Look
Skin now reacts to wetness in a more natural and realistic way, moving away from the glossy “plastic” look of earlier versions.



Eye Contact
Eye contact behavior is more precise, consistent, and responsive to your settings.



As always, this update includes numerous bug fixes and A LOT more improvements, check out the full list of updates below!



Take care

notes.title: Update 0.9.19
notes.content:
Hi friends,

for those interested in exploring the world of VR HOT beyond Steam (General News, our Patreon page with the VR HOT for Quest version and AI features, etc.), make sure to join our Discord server HERE or check out our Patreon page HERE!


This update brings a mix of practical improvements and cutting-edge features to enhance both performance and usability. One of the most noticeable changes is the new Player Calibration system. Previously complex and finicky, adjusting your virtual body to match your real-world proportions is now a lot easier and far more accurate.

We’ve also made substantial progress in player body control. Movements are now more stable and consistent, significantly reducing glitches and improving overall immersion. In line with this, we’ve removed the old “Dynamic” Player Position system and introduced a new default body handling method that is more predictable and less prone to issues.

A small but important control change: the default controller mapping for locomotion has been updated, with left and right controls swapped. If this doesn't suit your preference, you can easily adjust it via Main Menu > Settings > Controls.

For those on high-end hardware (4070 should be fine), we’re introducing experimental raytracing support. While still in early stages, this feature brings more realistic lighting and reflections to the experience—pushing visual fidelity to the next level.

Finally, we’ve resolved a long-standing issue with the SteamVR Tracker. It's now functioning reliably again, restoring full compatibility and improving tracking stability for SteamVR users.

As always, this update includes numerous bug fixes and more improvements, check out the full list of updates below!

Take care
VR HOT


Discord for PC (HottieCards, Support, etc.)
Website (incl. FAQs)
FOLLOW US!


Full list:

New
* Player Calibration - Adjusting the virtual body to match your real one is now easier than ever, thanks to a new calibration system. 
* Raytracing (Experimental) - Experience cutting-edge visuals with experimental raytracing support—available only on high-end PCs (>= 4070).
* Lips / Jaw Physics – No more awkward clipping! Lips and jaws now use colliders, resulting in far more realistic facial movement and interaction.
* HD Skins – Introducing three new high-definition skin options, including hi-res versions. These stunning visuals require about 1 GB of additional VRAM.
* More Male Hottie Sliders – Further customize your ideal hottie with new sliders for torso length, leg length, and arm length.
* Skin Transmission  – The skin now reacts more realistically to light - subtle translucency effects like sunlight shining through outer ears are now visible, adding depth and realism.

Improvements
* Player Body Control – More stable, more consistent.
* Cloth Simulation – Fabric movement has been improved and stabilized.
* Less Crashes caused by Physics – Fewer crashes related to physics systems. Who doesn't love a more stable game?
* Better and faster STT – Speech recognition is now significantly faster and more accurate.
* GI (Global Illumination) - Now also working with semi-transparent materials (cloth, body hair, water).
* DLSS - update to 3.7.20 (better looking + performing, especially in lower settings)
* Male Shoulder Joints – Shoulder movement looks more natural.
* Hottie Elbow Rotation - Elbows now deform less, maintaining a more accurate and attractive appearance.
* Hair Performance – Most hairstyles perform better now.
* Switch from Handtracking to Controllers – Switching from hand tracking to controllers is now more seamless and intuitive.
* Hair Quality – Hair rendering at a distance and in indirect lighting is improved, especially in the “Very High” setting.
* Eye Contact - Characters now switch between eye contact and looking away more naturally.
* Body Hair Rendering - Looking overall nicer now.
* Vagina / Anus Animation  - More realistic behavior.
* Self-shadow Quality - Well, just looking better now.

Changes
* Default Controller Mapping – Left and right controls for locomotion have been swapped by default.
* Removal of “Dynamic” Player Position – The default behavior of the player body has changed to reduce issues with body handling.
* Skin Specular Removed – Skin blush effects are now calculated automatically for a more natural appearance.
* Unity 6 Upgrade – We’ve upgraded to Unity 6. This is a major engine update, but you won’t notice much—it’s mostly under the hood.
* HottieCard Creation Overhaul – Another behind-the-scenes change with no visible difference to the user.

Bug Fixes
* SteamVR Tracker - is now functioning properly again.
* Tearline Glowing in Mirror
* Arm & Leg Shape Changes not correct - this fix might to lead to slightly different looking legs or arms on some existing Hotties.
* Male Hotties -  alignments not saving and loading correctly.
* On „Tropical Island“ - Artifacts at the Edge of FOV with „GI Character Only“

Known Issues
* Menus covering stuff (hands, etc.) (with upscaling)
* Mesh Artifacts in male Hotties and Player Bodies (Highly detailed Hotties)

As always, we appreciate your feedback and encourage you to share your thoughts in our Steam forums or on Discord. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 0.9.18
notes.content:
Hi friends,

first of all, for those interested in exploring the world of VR HOT beyond Steam (General News, our Patreon page with the Quest version and AI features, etc.), make sure to join our Discord server [HERE] or check out our Patreon [HERE]!

We're excited to bring you an update focused on performance improvements, along with new features and refinements to enhance your experience!

Performance Boost & Visual Enhancements
This update delivers a significant boost in performance. CPU and GPU memory usage and performance have been optimized to enhance stability and responsiveness. Several Beta testing users reported around 10fps more!
Cloth physics have been refined to eliminate artifacts and clipping in key areas - especially nipple clipping is nearly completely fixed. 

New Features
We're introducing several new features you have asked for. As known from the Quest version, you can now grab Clothing pieces! Touch the cloth with the tip of your index finger and use the grip button in VR or the left mouse button in Desktop mode. 
A brand-new inventory system lets you spawn toys directly into either hand, keeping them fixed in place until removed, eliminating the need for constant grabbing. 
In Intercourse Mode, you can now also grab male Hotties and rotate their whole body around the vertical axis of the room. Use your controllers and grab the Hottie preferably by the hips.  
To enhance realism, we've implemented advanced eye movement tracking with natural saccades, making character interactions feel more lifelike and engaging.

Improvements & Fixes
Character interactions and navigation have never been smoother. The transition between intimate and neutral animations has been refined for a more natural flow, ensuring a seamless experience. Position changes are now more intuitive, with quick access available directly from the upper menu layer, making adjustments more convenient than ever. 

As always, this update includes numerous bug fixes and more improvements, check out the full list of updates below!

Take care

New
* Realistic Eye Movement – Characters now have more lifelike gaze behavior with improved tracking and natural saccades.

* Inventory System for Toys – Spawn toys directly into your hands, where they stay fixed until removed—no need to grab them repeatedly.
* Male Hottie Rotation – Move and turn male Hotties (gently) around the Y axis.
* Adaptive Player Locomotion (Desktop Mode) – Movement now adjusts dynamically to floor height for a smoother experience.
* Testicle Length Slider – Probably self-explanatory.
* 12 New Clothing Items – Expand your wardrobe with fresh outfits, yay!

* Optimized Memory Usage – Reduced CPU and GPU load for a smoother experience.

* „Close Mouth“ command – Works more reliable

notes.title: Letter from the Devs: 0.5.6 - The RAM Hog
notes.content:
Hey friends,

as you might have noticed, we released and then had to pull back 0.5.6 again within hours.

The problem: With less than 24GB RAM it’s unfortunately unplayable.

Why? 

VR HOT is using the Unity engine. At the moment, Unity preloads a big part of the objects in the game at start, such as clothes, hair, etc. into the RAM - even the ones not in use. 

So far this hasn’t been a big problem, but the addition of new clothes, hairstyles and other things in 0.5.6 crossed the red line. We measured up to 14GB of RAM usage. Which we consider unacceptable, VR HOT should be playable on a PC with 16GB.

This means we have to change the architecture of the software, so Unity only loads the currently needed objects into the RAM.

The good news: It will run even better than before.

The bad news: This takes time. 

We are aiming for a temporary fix within 2-3 days. It will be playable again for those with only 16GB of RAM. 
To rebuild the architecture it will take weeks. But then it will need a lot less RAM than before and run better for everyone.

For those with at least 24GB RAM, you can still access 0.5.6 in the Beta Channel. Please follow these instructions:

- Open Steam
- Go to your Library
- Open the VR HOT product page
- Click on the little gear wheel on the upper right
- Click on "Properties"
- Click on "Betas"
- Choose "beta - internal testing" from the dropdown menu

Thanks for your patience and for supporting us!

Take care
VR HOT

notes.title: First Updates coming soon!
notes.content:
Hi friends!

First of all we want to thank the Steam community - all of you - for this overwhelming start! 
We didn't expect this much feedback - neither the positive messages and reviews nor the complaints, problems or criticism.

We are two old friends from Europe, working on VR HOT on the side of our main jobs. We don't have a team, no community manager or anyone else working for us. So yes, we are struggling to keep up with your questions and demands, but we're on it.

And yes, we heard you. Asking for updates, for transparency. So here's some answers.

To get this out of the way, this is what's coming up next:

FAQs (asap - TBA)
We are working on FAQs which we will put on our website and will be linked as "Online Manual URL" on the store page.

0.5.2.1 (asap - TBA) 
We can't tell a definite date yet as we are waiting for a new PC with an AMD GPU to be delivered. Several users reported a visual bug limited to AMD GPUs and we want to include a fix for this in 0.5.2.1
* several Bug Fixes
* including all 0.5.2 updates (Anal, Smooth Locomotion, Soft-body System, New Clothing System, new interactions, etc.)

0.5.3 (23.06.)
* BDSM Room
* New Interactions
* New Toys
* and more...

And here you can also see why we release some feature updates to our subscribed supporters first - although VR HOT is in the Early Access program, the standard and expectations on Steam are still very high. As you can witness in the reviews and discussions. 

That's totally fine, but we need a playground for experimental stuff, where we can develop new features in a smaller, very engaged community until they are stable and solid enough to be released on Steam. 

As you will see in the coming updates, Steam users benefit from this strategy by getting more reliable and stable updates. Another reason is that if you run into problems with a version, downgrading on Steam is not exactly easy. 
And if you want to get even closer to the project, the developers and development, you can support us there. 

We also heard you on the frequency of our updates. There will definitely be more than the 2-3/year we originally expected and planned. The first two we described above. But yes, on some feature updates there will be a delay until we feel confident about the stability and overall standard of the version.

There won't be a traditional road map. We will announce our priorities for the next couple of months from time to time, but apart from this we are working with an agile approach. Our plans will change continuously with your feedback, the market and technological development.

So, we hope we could answer some questions and make you feel more positive and optimistic about VR HOT on Steam. Keep up sending us your feedback and ideas, there is A LOT coming up in the next couple of months and we hope you are as excited about it as we are!

Take care
VR HOT
